lhs: Ordered minimum reduction across all participants, either returning the reduced array everywhere or selecting the receiver block for reduce-scatter.
rhs: Replicate the common scalar at every valid output coordinate.
conditions: Nonempty ordered group and a common spatially uniform scalar. Reduce-scatter axis length equals group size times arbitrary block width.
types: Exact integer ordering, arbitrary remaining logical coordinates including empty domains.
overlap: Both collective results are conjuncts of one case per comparator. Reuses the earlier block-address definition, integral order and idempotence, with the same fold argument for both extrema. Sum has different semantics.
